description: Add a new MCP server to the user configuration (~/.claude.json).

allow_footgun_args.description: Set true to override the safety refusal when args include code-injection flags like -e/--eval on node, -c on python/bash, -Command on pwsh, /c on cmd.

allow_footgun_env.description: Set true to override the safety refusal when env sets a code-injection key like NODE_OPTIONS, LD_PRELOAD, PYTHONSTARTUP, BASH_ENV.

allow_shell_metacharacters.description: Set true to override the safety refusal when 'command' contains shell metacharacters. Use only for genuinely shell-style commands you trust.

args.description: Arguments to pass to the command

command.description: Command to run (required for stdio transport)

env.description: Environment variables to set for the server

mcp_name.description: Name for the new MCP server (alphanumeric, dashes, underscores)

transport.description: Transport type: stdio for local process, http/sse for remote server

name: add_mcp
